target_proxy: EM FX panel geometric mean (7 currencies)
note: Empirical refit on EM FX panel. ARDL of log-diff EM FX index (equal-weighted geometric mean of 7 EM LCU/USD rates) on log-diff synthetic DXY. Long-run β is the cumulative response of the EM basket to a permanent 1% DXY appreciation.

target_proxy: PIMCO sovereign FX reserves panel (14 EMs, annual)
note: Empirical refit on PIMCO EM reserves panel. Pooled OLS of Δlog(reserves) on Δlog(DXY), annual 2011–2024. Country FE absorbed by within-country differencing. Sign expected negative (stronger DXY drains reserves); fitted_weight is the magnitude.
